==Usage==
Place the following code on the page and replace the "attraction name" with the appropriate information.

<code><nowiki>{{GalacticStarcruiser|''ATTRACTION NAME''|''FORMATTED NAME'' (optional)}}</nowiki></code>

The {{Para|nolink}} parameter can be used to override the automatic linking of the input.

==Example(s)==
<code><nowiki>{{GalacticStarcruiser|Sublight Lounge}}</nowiki></code>

Results in:

{{GalacticStarcruiser|Sublight Lounge}}

<code><nowiki>{{GalacticStarcruiser|Muster|nolink=1}}</nowiki></code>

Results in:

{{GalacticStarcruiser|Muster|nolink=1}}
